name: app/homepage.js
explanation: This module, `app/homepage.js`, implements the required frontend logic. It contains two primary rendering functions: `renderHomePage` (which includes the button) and `renderHelloWorldPage` (which prints 'Hello World'). The `renderView` function acts as a simple router dispatcher based on the provided route. Since the existing architecture is Python-based, this JS module is designed to be consumed by a frontend layer (e.g., served by Flask/Django/FastAPI via a template or a dedicated JS entry point called by `app/main.py`). The button uses a simulated global context (`window.appContext`) to trigger navigation, which the backend/main application must wire up.
